description: Source control for coding agents, running several of them side by side against one codebase and linking every commit back to the session, prompts and tool calls that produced it.
notes: Scoop expands the .msi administratively instead of running it, so the installer's WebView2 bootstrap never runs: Atlas needs an existing Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime, which Windows 11 and most Windows 10 installs already have (see the 'suggest' above).

Atlas keeps everything outside the scoop app directory: user data (state.json, threads.db, sessions, caches) in %APPDATA%\dev.atlas.ide, the WebView2 profile and logs in %LOCALAPPDATA%\dev.atlas.ide, and preferences in ~/.config/atlas/config.toml. Scoop uninstall removes none of them - delete all three to clean up completely.
